generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Work Experience certificate issued by the officer not below the rank Deputy Conservator of Forests for having carried out the similar type of works in Karnataka Forest Department
Aadhar Card, PAN and Permanent Address
Affidavit on Rs. 100 Stamp Paper certifying that he is not blacklisted and not involved in any forest/criminal cases
Annual Turnover certificate at least two financial years (2024-25 to 2025-26)
GST Registration and GST Clearance Certificate (GST Returns from 2024-25 to 2025-26)

itemList.description: Maintenance of elephant-proof trench of size 3.0 mtr top width 3.0 m depth and 1.5 mtr bottom width with an initial lead up to 3 M. and depositing the excavated soil uniformly over the inner side of the elephant-proof trench and forming conical mound of height 1.5 m, including compacting the mound on the inner side of the EPT with excavated soil (Almost all is by MAchine)
